FN-EH5622-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 264
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/28/2023
Senate Bill 264 as introduced would require a public K-12 school or local board of education to
accept cash along with any other form of payment of its choosing, for admission to
school-sponsored sporting events. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
